text:
Freight shipping currently only supports locations on Earth using 5-character UN/LOCODE identifiers (such as `CNSHA` for Shanghai, `DEHAM` for Hamburg, or `USOAK` for Oakland). Additionally, supported transport modes are **OCEAN**, **AIR**, and **TRUCK**.

Please provide a valid origin location on Earth (or its city/port name) and the specific ship date next week so I can look up available rate cards for you!
